name: Aria Hotel Prague
positioning: A music-themed hotel in Prague's UNESCO Historic Center, just across the Charles Bridge from Old Town, with a private entrance to the Baroque Vrtba Garden
best_for: Music lovers drawn to floors themed on Contemporary, Classical, Opera and Jazz music and a library of more than 5,000 CDs and DVDs
Travelers who want a quiet base within walking distance of Prague Castle
Families using the two-bedroom Beethoven Luxury Suite

facts.text: The hotel is just across the Charles Bridge from Old Town, within Prague's UNESCO Historic Center.
Prague Castle is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
The tram is two minutes away for sightseeing in the historic center.
The room interiors were created by Italian designers Rocco Magnoli and Lorenzo Carmellini, whose work can also be seen in many Versace stores and hotels.
Rooms have a Hi-Fi audio system with a Marantz amplifier, Apple TV and AirPlay, so guests can send music and photos from their own Apple devices to the in-room TV and speakers.
Bathrooms feature Molton Brown cosmetics and a European soaking tub or a rain shower, or both.
Rooms face the inner courtyard, the road or Vrtba Garden, and thick walls, heavy drapes and carpeting keep them very quiet.
The Mozart Luxury Two Bedroom Suite has a splendid view of the Baroque Vrtba Garden.
The two-bedroom Beethoven Luxury Suite is designed for families, decorated in an elegant classical style and overlooks the UNESCO Vrtba Garden.
The ground floor has a light-filled winter garden atrium and a library with a fireplace and 20 red bookshelves of music books.
The hotel has a small six-seat cinema.
A sweet afternoon tea is included in the room rate; in warmer months it switches to prosecco with savory snacks.

highlights.text: The hotel has a private entrance to Vrtba Garden, an Italian-style Baroque terrace-garden dating to 1715.
Each of the hotel's four floors is devoted to a different music genre: Contemporary, Classical, Opera and Jazz.
The fifth-floor rooftop terrace has a panoramic view of Prague's red-tiled rooftops, St. Nicholas Church and the towers of Prague Castle.
Guests have access to the hotel's Music Library of more than 5,000 CDs and DVDs, also available via Apple TV in their room.
The Blues Luxury Suite is a spacious duplex with ceiling windows and a view of the Vrtba Garden.

considerations.text: The rooftop terrace is open from April to October.
The hotel's public spaces are all wheelchair accessible, and there are two accessible rooms.
WhataHotel notes the hotel's boutique size means limited room inventory, so booking ahead may be needed.
